name: A Bad Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop takes charge when a hippogryph egg cannot be saved.

sections.title: An Egg Beyond Saving
sections.body: Some hippogryph eggs cannot be saved. Curgle Cranklehop handles those that will never hatch.

sections.title: What Becomes of It
sections.body: Curgle takes the egg away for proper disposal. Not every egg can be saved, Curgle says. You can try again with another egg from Feralas.

aliases: who do i give bad egg to
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop accepts the bad egg.
No. A bad egg cannot be saved and will never hatch.
